raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`setup_mega_attention` folds the MegaAttention query head layout into `wq_b`'s rows (`interleave_query_rows`) only when `wq_b` is a native MXFP8 linear. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ships a `[32, 32]` block-FP8 checkpoint whose dense linears run through the same FlashInfer MXFP8 GEMM via the block-FP8-as-MXFP8 view (`block_fp8_mxfp8_ready`), so `mega_wq_b_permuted` stays false and every layer packs the query at forward time with `pack_query`: a `new_zeros` of the `[tokens, 64, 512]` bf16 query and a strided transpose copy into it.

Measured on GB300, DEP2 (TP2 + DP attention, EP2, MegaMoE, decoder bounded replay, Mega-mHC on), one cold 16,384-token prefill chunk per rank, torch profiler:

| per 16K step, rank 0 | count | per launch | total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `aten::new_zeros` (vectorized fill) | 40 | 141 µs | 5.7 ms |
| `aten::copy_` (strided `direct_copy` elementwise) | 40 | 691 µs | 27.6 ms |

That is 33 ms of a 322 ms step (10%) and 80 launches on an eager step that is dispatch-bound (median inter-kernel gap 41 µs). Per layer it writes ~1.2 GB of zeros and moves ~2.4 GB through a non-contiguous copy.

## Modifications

- `_wq_b_uses_flashinfer_mxfp8` also accepts a block-FP8 `wq_b` served as MXFP8 (`block_fp8_as_mxfp8` on the FlashInfer CUTLASS / CuTe-DSL backend), so `mega_wq_b_permuted` is set for this checkpoint.
- In `setup_mega_attention`, for that case: `interleave_query_rows` moves 16-row groups, so the `[32, 32]` block scale is refined to 16 rows, permuted the same way as the weight, and rebound as `weight_scale_inv` with `weight_block_size = [16, 32]`. The existing post-load pass then builds the swizzled MXFP8 scale from it as for any block-FP8-as-MXFP8 layer. The native MXFP8 path is unchanged.

After this `pack_query` is skipped for the block-FP8 checkpoint exactly as for native MXFP8 ones.

Numerics: the same FP8 bytes and the same e8m0 scales reach the GEMM, only in the row order the attention kernel already consumes; refining a 32-row block scale to 16-row blocks is exact.

## Measured

GB300, DEP2 (TP2 + DP attention, EP2), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MegaMoE, Mega-mHC, decoder bounded replay, eager prefill, 16K-token prefill budget per rank, rank 0. Main (job 3470, `2d3dd3168d`) against this branch (job 3476). Startup log on the branch: `MegaAttention wq_b query-layout permute: applied=True (block-fp8 served as mxfp8)`.

| Unprofiled, median of 3 | main | this PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| One 16K-token cold chunk per rank (ms) | 247 | 235 |
| 128K-token prompt in eight 16K chunks (ms) | 1,906 | 1,764 |

| Profiled 16K step | main | this PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| `new_zeros` fill and strided `copy_` launches per step | 80 (33.9 ms) | 0 |
| Kernel launches per step | 1,847 | 1,756 |
| Attention section per layer (mHC kernel to the MoE block's mHC kernel), median over layers (ms) | 5.03 | 3.39 |

The cached-prefix cells of the same run moved both ways by up to 15% between runs and are not reported.

Before: main, layer 6, 5.00 ms and 17 launches between the two mHC kernels; the fill (264 µs) and the strided copy (1.30 ms) sit between `k_norm_rope` and the attention kernel.

![main, layer 6 attention section](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kpham-sgl/sglang/assets-prefill-h2h-2026-10-16/prefill-h2h-2026-10-16/main-job3470-layer6-attention-section.jpg)

After: this branch, same layer, 3.36 ms and 15 launches.

![this PR, layer 6 attention section](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kpham-sgl/sglang/assets-prefill-h2h-2026-10-16/prefill-h2h-2026-10-16/pr44838-job3476-layer6-attention-section.jpg)

Not run yet: the GSM8K native-acceptance gate.

detail.title: [Perf] deepseek_v4: fold the MegaAttention query layout into wq_b for block-FP8-as-MXFP8 checkpoints

files.patch:
@@ -1377,17 +1377,39 @@ def setup_mega_attention(self) -> None:
             self.n_local_heads in (64, 128) and self._wq_b_uses_flashinfer_mxfp8()
         )
         if self.mega_wq_b_permuted:
-            for param in (self.wq_b.weight, self.wq_b.weight_scale_inv):
-                param.data.copy_(interleave_query_rows(param.data, self.n_local_heads))
-            self.wq_b.quant_method._process_mxfp8_linear_weight_scale(self.wq_b)
+            method = self.wq_b.quant_method
+            if method.use_mxfp8:
+                for param in (self.wq_b.weight, self.wq_b.weight_scale_inv):
+                    param.data.copy_(
+                        interleave_query_rows(param.data, self.n_local_heads)
+                    )
+                method._process_mxfp8_linear_weight_scale(self.wq_b)
+            else:
+                block_n, block_k = method.weight_block_size
+                sf = self.wq_b.weight_scale_inv.data.repeat_interleave(
+                    block_n // 16, dim=0
+                )
+                sf = (
+                    sf.view(self.n_local_heads, 32, -1)
+                    .transpose(0, 1)
+                    .reshape(sf.shape)
+                )
+                self.wq_b.weight.data.copy_(
+                    interleave_query_rows(self.wq_b.weight.data, self.n_local_heads)
+                )
+                self.wq_b.weight_scale_inv.data = sf.contiguous()
+                method.weight_block_size = [16, block_k]
         wo_a = self.wo_a.weight.view(self.n_local_groups, self.o_lora_rank, -1)
         self.mega_wo_a = quantize_wo_a(interleave_output_columns(wo_a))
 
     def _wq_b_uses_flashinfer_mxfp8(self) -> bool:
         method = self.wq_b.quant_method
         backend = getattr(method, "mxfp8_dense_backend", None)
         return bool(
-            getattr(method, "use_mxfp8", False)
+            (
+                getattr(method, "use_mxfp8", False)
+                or getattr(method, "block_fp8_as_mxfp8", False)
+            )
             and backend is not None
             and (backend.is_flashinfer_cutlass() or backend.is_flashinfer_cutedsl())
         )
